title: Chapter 311: Zerg And The Weird Face-To-Face Battle
content:
Chapter 311: Zerg And The Weird Face-To-Face Battle

The weird creatures are different from normal creatures. They seem to be able to ignore the rules of space and appear in very strange ways.

The Zerg army no longer has the front and rear. As long as the Zerg army is exposed outside the protection range of the lord, even the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion protected by the Zerg puppy in the back, it will also be attacked by various weird creatures that suddenly appear.

"Interesting! It seems to be the overlap of different spaces!"

"The current weird creatures are too weak, and it just happens that each type of soldier can test the effect of attacking the weird creatures!"

With Wu Qing's current strength, he found some reasons why the weird creatures can ignore space.

No matter how mysterious the weird creatures are, they cannot escape the restrictions of the rules of the universe. They can only exist in the states of matter, energy and spiritual consciousness. Energy is actually also classified as matter, but it is more special and is classified into a separate category.

The Zerg can be immune to mental attacks because of the existence of the Queen, but the Zerg cannot attack the weird creatures that exist in the state of spiritual consciousness under normal circumstances.

In the past, the Queen used the Zerg host to attack the weirdness of the mental state. Now it is found that the attack of the five-star Zerg Devourer hurts the weirdness of the mental state, so Wu Qing wants to test the killing situation of the Zerg arms against the weirdness.

All the Zerg arms participating in the battle went out to participate in the battle and conduct attack tests.

After a series of tests, the final result is that the five-star Zerg Devourer, the five-star Zerg Sky Guard and all the six-star arms can hurt the weirdness of the mental state.

Other Zerg arms can only hurt the weirdness of the material and energy states.

"Is it because of the arms or the strength?"

Wu Qing casually upgraded a Zerg puppy, a three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion, a Zerg flying dragon and a Zerg explosive mosquito to five stars.

Then send these newly upgraded five-star arms to attack the weirdness of the mental state. With the existence of the Zerg host, the weirdness of the mental state that was originally invisible appeared clearly in the eyes of the Zerg.

The arm blade of the five-star Zerg puppy slashed at a black mist-like weirdness, and the black mist suddenly turned into a distorted big face, wailing in pain, and then disappeared, turning into a faint light and being absorbed by the system.

The test results of the five-star three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion, the five-star Zerg flying dragon and the five-star Zerg explosive mosquito were consistent with the Zerg puppy. Their attacks could hurt the weirdness of the mental consciousness state.

"With five-star strength, the attack already has a certain amount of spiritual will power, and it is not surprising that it can kill spiritual consciousness!"

"Ordinary attacks below five-star strength are basically ineffective against weirdness. No wonder people in this world are afraid of weirdness!"

"A weak weirdness in the state of spiritual consciousness, people below five stars in this world have no effective means to deal with it!"

"They themselves may not be harmed by such weak weirdness, but they can't protect others!"

"Ordinary people are simply powerless to resist when facing all kinds of strange mental attacks!"

Wu Qing knows that for people in this world, there are ways to deal with the weirdness of material and energy states, but the weirdness of mental consciousness is very scary.

If the Zerg are all individuals with independent consciousness, they will also encounter this problem. The various weird mental attacks will make the soldiers of the army dizzy and fall into various illusions, and all lose their combat capabilities.

Fortunately, every individual of the Zerg is a queen. If Wu Qing wants to be stronger than the collective consciousness queen of the Zerg at the level of mental power, he doesn't know if there is such a thing in this world.

…

The Zerg Hound and the Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion split up, with the Zerg Hound attacking outside the lord's protection range of the ancient desert territory alone.

Without the distinction between the front and the back, the Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion, which basically has no melee ability, is not suitable for such a battlefield. They retreat and let the Zerg Hound, who is good at melee combat, go alone.

Facing the weaker weirdness, the Zerg Hound kills all tangible weirdness, ignores those weirdness in the state of mental consciousness, and continues to advance into the desert in the night.

For those weirdness in the state of mental consciousness that remain, the five-star Zerg troops did not attack, but the Zerg host controlled by the Queen.

The Queen uses the latest research on the application of mental power to control the Zerg host to use their own powerful mental power to attack various weirdness in the state of mental consciousness.

The Zerg host is like using mental power to pierce balloons, piercing those weirdness in the state of mental consciousness one by one, turning into light and disappearing, and becoming system resources.

All five million Zerg flying dragons joined the battle. They flew out of the lord's protection area in the night like a dark cloud, supporting the Zerg puppies on the ground, and fighting against strange and weird creatures that suddenly appeared around them.

Under the yellow sand, huge monsters broke out of the sand from time to time and devoured the Zerg puppies, and the Zerg puppies would seize the opportunity to attach themselves to them and launch fierce close-range attacks. The Zerg with the talent of drilling the ground, even if they were taken underground, was their home ground.

Wu Qing couldn't see how many weird things there were outside, but as long as the Zerg army entered the weird territory, there would be weird things to fight with them, leaving no Zerg idle.

In the desert of the ancient desert territory, waves of black tides surged on the yellow sand. They were Zerg puppies coming from all directions.

The Zerg puppies that came rushed directly out of the lord's protection area and fought with the weird.

Soon, there were tens of millions of Zerg puppies fighting with the weird.

The attacks of the Zerg Devourer and the Zerg Sky Guard, except for special spores that will not infect the Zerg, the Zerg have to bear all other damage by themselves. The real world is not a game. Except for some special attacks, most normal attacks are not divided into enemies and friends.

If you hit your own people and can't defend, you will die.

The various advantages of the Zerg army when facing the evil god camp no longer exist in this battlefield fighting against the weird.

The Zerg also has to keep pace with the times. A large number of Zerg hosts rushed over. Under the unified command of the Queen of Zerg, they formed a formation, used their own spiritual power, and used a spiritual attack method similar to the spiritual storm of the Ghoul Sage to kill all kinds of weird on a large scale.

No matter what form of weird, there is an undying spiritual will on the body, or integrated into flesh and blood, or integrated into energy, or integrated into various weird things.

Physical and energy attacks can kill them by destroying the deposits of this spiritual will, and spiritual power attacks can also directly wipe them out from the spiritual will level.

It can be said that the strong who cultivate spiritual power are the nemesis of all kinds of weirdness.

"If the interstellar gods are born, the weirdness of this world will see what true restraint is!"

Wu Qing is very much looking forward to the interstellar gods who use spiritual power to perfection. After obtaining system optimization, what kind of changes will they bring to this world.

After the Zerg obtains the status of a large clan, it should face the weirdness and many secrets of this world.

If the system can release Wu Qing's men in the system-affiliated world, it will be even better. There are countless powerful beings in the system-affiliated world. Any army can sweep away the enemies Wu Qing sees.

Wu Qing can only think about these. Now he still needs to rely on the Zerg to kill the enemy and work hard for the birth of the system-affiliated world and the interstellar gods.

When the Zerg host uses spiritual power to participate in the war, this attack method that does not cause any harm to the Zerg army begins to eliminate the weirdness by clearing the field.

No matter what form the weirdness took, the Zerg host's spiritual power storm swept through, and all of them turned into light and disappeared, no longer existing.

Under the restrained attack of the Zerg host, the number of weirdness decreased greatly.

"Squeak...! Ga...!"

Two meaningless screams suddenly came from the desert battlefield under the night.

It seemed to be audible, but also silent.

The desert battlefield fell into a terrible silence.

Suddenly, a large number of irregular black blocks that were darker than the night appeared in various parts of the Zerg army, and countless octopus-like weird creatures poured out of the black blocks!

It was like a bucket filled with countless octopuses pouring down!

The octopus-like weirdness with strange colors, squeezed into a ball, rolled down from the black block with their teeth and claws bared.

They were big and small, visible and invisible, and all kinds of them mixed together and fell into the Zerg puppy group.

Those giant octopus monsters that were closer to the Zerg host seemed to treat the space as sea water. They opened their octopus claws and pounced on the Zerg host as soon as they bounced in the air.

These giant octopus monsters were powerful and strange, and the Zerg host's own mental power was not enough to stop their attack.

A trace of the power of the Queen of the Zerg descended on the Zerg host. The extremely domineering mental power ignored any characteristics of the giant octopus monsters and directly blew them up.

The average strength of this batch of octopus monsters was very strong, and their attack methods were extremely strange. They fell in large numbers and quickly among the Zerg puppies, causing a large number of casualties among the Zerg puppies.

The gap in strength between the two sides was too large, and the Zerg puppies' attacks basically could not break the slippery outer layer of the octopus monsters.

And the Zerg puppies could not resist the various attacks of the octopus monsters.

The Zerg flying dragon group flying in the air was also attacked by some strange octopus monsters.

As soon as the Zerg flying dragon group and the octopus monsters fought, they knew the gap in strength. They could not beat them and could only quickly retreat to the lord's protection range.

The Zerg host's mental attack, due to its own strength, had a much reduced killing effect on the Octopus.

More high-star Zerg hosts joined the attack, even those five-star transport Zerg hosts joined the attack.

After the Queen of Zerg used her power once, she was targeted by a mysterious force. If the Queen of Zerg made another move, if she fought with the existence in the dark, the Zerg army here would probably be annihilated.

Therefore, the Queen of Zerg did not make another move.
